owners.writfold-app: Typed method lookup, lifecycle/schema/capability refusal precedence, generation allocation and prepare-before-commit orchestration
owners.writfold-wire: Strict bounded envelopes, exact ID kinds, closed parameter/data schemas and borrowed LF-inclusive response encoding
owners.writfold-protocol: Actual checked generation allocation, exact instance/incarnation/request correlation and refusal-preserving lifecycle transitions

proof_mapping.meaning: Executable-body identity/state/generation guarantees and intended-declaration negative calibrations. This is not a machine-checked whole native transport, JSON parser, syscall, entropy, or CLI-to-Lean refinement theorem.

native_obligations: actual static x86_64 musl binary and clean line-delimited stdout
all pinned contract sequences through real subprocess pipes
exact LF-inclusive request boundary and oversize draining/recovery
fragmented, EOF and invalid UTF-8/JSON behavior
exact string/null/arbitrary integer correlation without float narrowing
bounded complete response or connection termination without partial bytes/ID substitution
notification silence and shutdown without processing subsequent input
SIGTERM during partial pending input and broken output pipe
self-contained exact contract archive, reproducibility, standalone inspection and hostile archive refusal

scenario_relationships.X23: Contributes this no-backend-child control process cancellation/bounded IO only; owned child-tree/resource and uncertain-effect guarantees remain separate.
scenario_relationships.X20,X37,X38,X61,X62,X75,X78,X85: Not established: pinned corpus pages, continuation leases, contrary evidence, semantic context and prepared authoritative views require their actual services.

trust_boundaries: OS entropy labels are invocation-local transport identity, not durable KB ownership or a grant.
Contract/artifact digests establish byte identity relative to the pinned owner artifact, not authenticity or truth by themselves.
JSON Schema does not replace lexical integer rules, checked selector ordering/preimages, live authorization or retained provenance.
Application dispatch and native IO are exercised; only explicitly mapped protocol bodies receive the stated Verus coverage.
Control faults are rejected/no-effect outcomes. Future Splicery or other effects require distinct Unknown/partial outcome projection, retained reservations and reconciliation.
blocked_scope: P01O/WF24 retained-branch relocation; no rerun or fallback
authorized realm/context/completed release and live citation/assessment readers
finite collections, pinned read closure and bounded large-artifact transfer
Worktrunk/run-owned editing, durable ledger/effects and learning admission
